purpose: endpoint usage per invocation: the probe needed three invocations to complete the 40 fixed items, and the manifest only accounts for the last one

attempts.outcome: stopped before the cell finished (no traceback in the log; the process was terminated externally); the 7 answers survived in the raw file and were reused by attempt 3

attempts.resilience: as attempt 2, with the client timeout sized from measured call latency

resume_guarantee: the 7 reused records were validated by the resume guard against the prompt this run would send (per-record prompt sha256), so all 40 records carry the same prompt design even though 7 were produced by instrument revision 0e5cc6b
cause: the driving agent and the probe target are served by the same inference engine: measured 20-60 s per call on an idle engine and 130-145 s while the driving agent was generating, with abandoned requests continuing to generate server-side and blocking the next call
corrective_rule: future rounds start the run detached (setsid nohup with a pidfile) and keep the driving turn minimal until the run finishes, instead of supervising it from a live generation turn
